subtitle: Lesson 46 · Linked Servers & Connectivity

code:
SELECT o.OrderID, o.OrderDate, c.CompanyName
FROM SQLSRV02.SalesDB.dbo.Orders AS o
JOIN SQLSRV02.SalesDB.dbo.Customers AS c
    ON c.CustomerID = o.CustomerID
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2026-01-01';

-- server.database.schema.object
caption: Reads almost like a local query. The local optimizer decides how much runs remotely.

code:
SELECT *
FROM OPENQUERY(SQLSRV02,
  'SELECT OrderID, OrderDate, CustomerID
   FROM SalesDB.dbo.Orders
   WHERE OrderDate >= ''2026-01-01''');

-- Query text runs entirely on the remote server.
caption: Only the already-filtered result set crosses the network.
